newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek bourse trims early losses, ends flat.
newsitem.headline: Greek bourse trims early losses, ends flat.

text.p: The Athens bourse ended flat after a late session buying spree erased early session losses with the benchmark index settling at 1,268.90, up 0.02 percent.
"The bourse is consolidating. On Friday, turnover rose as a result of buying interest for banking shares," said floor trader Vassilis Fassoulas, at Macedonia-Thrace Securities.
Investors are awaiting official results and dividend anniuncements. He saw the market consolidating next week between 1,250 and 1,300 points.
On Thursday, Greece's capital commission fined Atemke's managing director Thomas Georgakis 250 billion drachmas for manipulative trading on shares of Parnassos in the Delta Securities scandal.

The Athens general share index ended flat, 0.02 percent or 0.23 points higher at 1,268.90 points from Thursday's 1,268.67 after opening at 1266.02. Turnover was higher at 10.7 billion drachmas on volume of 2.9 million shares.
Decliners led advancers 128 to 77 with 34 issues unchanged on 239 traded.

Construction closed 1.72 percent lower but banks rose 0.57 percent. Industrials slipped 0.15 percent and small caps dropped 1.39 percent. Investment shares ended 0.61 percent higher and leasing stocks lost 1.02 percent.
